headerDisplay: Shows the Fronius Ohmpilot water temperature in HomeKit, with an optional switch to turn Boost mode on and off.

host.title: Inverter IP address
host.description: IP or hostname of the Fronius inverter / Datamanager that provides the Solar API.

ohmpilotHost.title: Ohmpilot IP address
ohmpilotHost.description: IP or hostname of the Ohmpilot's own web page. Leave empty to hide the Boost switch.

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often the temperature and Boost state are refreshed in the background.

boostRefreshDelay.title: Boost refresh delay (seconds)
boostRefreshDelay.description: How long to wait after switching Boost before reading the state again.
